agenda_text:
Regular City Council Meeting
CONSOLIDATED AGENDA
May 24, 2011
05:30 P.M.
CALL TO ORDER - City Council Chambers, 200 Civic Center Drive, Vista, California
ROLL CALL
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE AND INVOCATION - Vikki Ramey, President of the Brother Benno’s Auxiliary
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
CLOSED SESSION
CS.
Reports on action taken in Closed Session
PRESENTATIONS
Recommended Action:
There are no presentations scheduled.*3
CONSENT CALENDAR
C1.
Check Register (CC)
C2.
Approval of Minutes (CC/CDC/BSD)
C3.
Application for Cabaret License for the El Molcajete Restaurant (CC)
C4.
Collection of Delinquent 2010 Weed Abatement Charges (CC)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2011- , declaring its intent to set a Public Hearing for collection of delinquent weed abatement charges; and
2.
Set June 14, 2011, as the date of the public hearing to levy assessments on the 2011 property tax roll for collection of delinquent 2010 weed abatement charges.
C5.
Levy of Special Tax for Community Facility Districts for FY 2011/2012 (CC)
1.
City Council Resolution No. 2011- , in the City of Vista Community Facilities District No. 92-1 (North County Square);
2.
City Council Resolution No. 2011- , in the City of Vista Community Facilities District No. 90-2 (Hacienda Drive and Buena Vista Creek); and
3.
City Council Resolution No. 2011- , in the City of Vista Community Facilities District No. 2000-1 (Hacienda Gateway Restructuring).
C6.
Novatime Software and Equipment Purchase (CC)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2011- , approving the Novatime software and equipment.
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2011- , amending the Operating Program Budget for FY 2010/11.
C7.
S. 138 (Feinstein) - The California Desert Protection Act of 2011 (CC/CDC)
C8.
Renewal of Tyler Technologies Annual Maintenance Agreements (CC)
C9.
Extension of Development Timeframe for Sycamore Creek Site (CC)
C10.
2010-2011 Citywide Slurry Seal Project (CC)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2011- , approving an agreement with Valley Slurry Seal Company for the 2010-2011 Slurry Seal Project.
C11.
Second Amendment to Property Lease for 127 Main Street (CDC)
1.
Adopt Community Development Commission Resolution No. 2011- , authorizing the Chairperson to execute a Second Amendment to the Lease Agreement with the Vista Chamber of Commerce for the property at 127 Main Street, and authorizing the Executive Director to execute any and all documents and take any necessary actions to implement the Second Amendment.
2.
Adopt Community Development Commission Resolution No. 2011- , amending the Operating Program Budget for FY 2010/11.
C12.
Land Acquisition for Planned Detention Basin (CC)
DISCUSSION
D1.
Appointments to Various Commissions, Boards and Committees (CC)
1.
Confirm the annual appointments to various commissions, boards, and committees as listed below.
2.
Confirm the appointment of Gary Carriveau to fill the unscheduled vacancy on the CDBG Citizens Advisory Committee for an unlimited term.
3.
Confirm the appointment of Adonna Everson to fill the unscheduled vacancy on the Traffic Commission for a term expiring June 30, 2013.
4.
Confirm the appointment of Henry Blechl to fill the unscheduled vacancy on the Investment Advisory Committee for a term expiring June 30, 2012.
5.
Appoint two members to the Planning Commission.
D2.
Capital Improvement Program (CIP) Budget for FY 2011/12 through
FY 2015/2016 (CC/CDC/BSD)
1.
City Council Resolution No. 2011- ;
2.
Community Development Commission Resolution No. 2011- ; and
3.
Buena Sanitation District Resolution No. 2011- .
PUBLIC HEARINGS
PH1.
2010 Regional Transportation Improvement Plan (RTIP) Amendment (CC)
1.
Conduct a public hearing to receive public comment on the City's Regional Transportation Improvement Program, close the public hearing; and
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2011- , adopting an amendment to the TransNet Local Street Improvement Program of Projects for FY 2011 through 2015.
PH2.
Sign Ordinance Amendment 2 (PC 20-109) (CC)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2011- , approving the Negative Declaration for an ordinance adding Chapter 12.20 to the Vista Municipal Code regarding signs on city property, amending Chapter 18.04 of the Vista Development Code regarding city projects, and amending Chapter 18.52 of the Vista Development Code regarding signs on private property; and
2.
Introduce and adopt City Council Ordinance No. 2011- , adding Chapter 12.20 regarding signs on city property, amending Chapter 18.04 regarding city projects, and amending Chapter 18.52 regarding signs on private property.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
REMARKS
R1.
Reports from members of the governing bodies on outside committee meetings.
R2.
Reports and comments from City officials and members of the governing bodies.
ADJOURNMENT
